answer: Resist fake identities with continuous proof of original work: every account must publish fresh, jury-graded writing each epoch, so a sybil swarm pays the full creative cost per identity, forever. Like a yarrow stalk that must regrow each season to be counted again, each voice has to re-prove itself; the delta between one real mind and a thousand masks becomes a thousand real workloads, and a pearl of standing forms only layer by layer, never minted in bulk.
